name: 239 Handyman Can
dm_message: Hi Mike, this is Michael from Merktop. Saw 239 Handyman Can's 4.6 rating on Google and noticed you don't have a website yet, so I built a free sample one for you: https://siteforge-demos.odd-forest-9504.workers.dev/239-handyman-can-capecoral/ It doesn't touch your business in any way. Like it? We can move it to your own domain. Not for you? We'll take it down, no obligation.

owner.name: Mike
owner.note: First name confirmed independently across 5 different Google reviews (William Wills, Marina Ford, Brian Salkeld, Nicolle Jackson, Chad Sund all refer to the handyman by the name 'Mike'). No last name found published anywhere. The Google Business Profile shows an owner response signed generically ('Thank you very much for the review.'), no separate owner name field exposed.

phone_source: Google Maps live listing (gmaps_detail.js), field 'Phone: +1 239-460-5929', confirmed across 3 separate live fetches on 2026-08-14.
email_note: No public email found. Searched: WebSearch for business name + email/contact, no Facebook page found under this exact business name (only unrelated same-niche businesses in Cape Coral: Jon The Handyman Can, Cape Coral Handyman, Soarin' Handyman Services, EZPZ Handyman Services, Smith & Son's Handyman Services, Leave It To Us Handyman -- all ruled out, different phone numbers/owners), no Instagram account found under '239 Handyman Can' or plausible handles, no BBB/Angi/HomeAdvisor listing found under this exact name. Left null per no-invention rule.
social_note: No verified Instagram or Facebook page found for this specific business after multiple targeted searches (business name, phone number, owner-adjacent terms). Several same-niche Cape Coral handyman Facebook pages surfaced but were confirmed unrelated (different names/phones). Google Maps (with 11 reviews and 4.6 rating) is the only verified public channel besides the phone number.
address_note: Google Maps does not publish a street address for this listing (address field returned null across 3 live fetches; likely a mobile/home-based operation with no public storefront, consistent with 82% of handyman-niche businesses in the pipeline's own registry). JSON-LD and the site's Location section use only addressLocality/addressRegion/addressCountry (Cape Coral, FL, US), no streetAddress. Per pipeline rule ('sin direccion completa = omitir mapa y usar foto real'), the map iframe was omitted and replaced with a real photo (hero-lanai.jpg) in the Location section.
hours_note: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday closed. Source: Google Maps live listing (gmaps_detail.js hours field), confirmed via live fetch on 2026-08-14.
rating_source: Google Maps live listing, confirmed via 3 separate live fetches (gmaps_detail.js) on 2026-08-14: rating 4.6, review summary block explicitly states '11 reviews'. Matches the rating/count given in the discovery brief.
own_site_check: gmaps_detail.js confirmed website: null across 3 live fetches (Maps panel shows 'Add website' button, meaning Google has no website on file). WebSearch for '239 Handyman Can LLC website' and '239 Handyman Can Cape Coral FL website' returned no matching own-domain result (only unrelated businesses: Jon The Handyman Can, Handy Jamy, Capecoralhandymanllc.com, handymanservicecapecoral.com -- all different businesses, ruled out). Tested candidate domain 239handymancan.com directly via curl: resolves (HTTP 200) but serves a bare Squarespace 'Coming Soon' parking page with no business content, no logo, no contact info -- not a functional website. Tested 239handymancanllc.com and handymancan239.com: both fail to resolve (curl exit 56 / no connection). Conclusion: has_own_site remains false; the parked domain is noted as a possible future site but is not currently a real website with content.
domain_note: 239handymancan.com is registered and returns a generic Squarespace 'Coming Soon' page (title tag '239handymancan.com', no logo, no text, no contact info beyond the Squarespace placeholder chrome). This is not a functioning website and does not disqualify the lead; noted for context only.
services_note: No booking platform and no published price list (typical for this niche: 82% of handyman-niche businesses in the pipeline publish phone but not pricing). Services below are derived from two real, verifiable sources: (1) Google review text (verbatim, see reviews below) mentioning specific completed jobs, and (2) the Google Maps 'service mentions' aggregation (aria-label tags: 'driveway power washing, mentioned in 2 reviews', 'fair pricing, mentioned in 4 reviews', 'thoroughness, mentioned in 2 reviews', 'garage, mentioned in 2 reviews'), and (3) the business's own uploaded Google Maps photos, which show real completed jobs: a mounted TV + assembled bedroom furniture, a hand-built raised garden bed, a lattice privacy fence, a wood-plank lanai ceiling, and a newly installed electrical panel. No prices shown anywhere; the site uses 'Call for a quote' throughout.

reviews.text: Mike did an amazing job insulating my garage doors. Super looking and he cleaned up everything. I would highly recommend him. Great prices too. I will be using him again for more things.
reviews.author: William Wills

reviews.text: Mike provided very reasonable pricing, and was very quick, efficient, and knowledgeable. He installed 4 ceiling fans for us in 2 hours, which was the initial timeframe he estimated it would take. He thoroughly answered all of our questions.
reviews.author: Marina Ford

reviews.text: Mike helped me last minute with my wife's vehicle. He literally manufactured a special tool to make the repair. He used his vehicle to accommodate me as we were down a vehicle. I also used him for dock repair at my parents home.
reviews.author: Brian Salkeld

reviews.text: Mike came to the rescue when we needed him. He was so prompt to respond, was very kind, and got to the task very quickly. He hung my mother's Christmas lights and she absolutely adored him! He did such a great job.
reviews.author: Nicolle Jackson

reviews.text: Known Mike for nearly 30 years, and in that time I can honestly say there has never been a task he can't accomplish, from home repairs to rebuilding engines, to building custom corn hole boards for a weekend get together he can do it all!
reviews.author: Chad Sund

reviews_note: All 5 verbatim quotes with author names pulled directly from the live Google Maps reviews panel (gmaps_detail.js reviews tab scrape) on 2026-08-14. 3 of the 5 (William Wills, Marina Ford, Nicolle Jackson) are used verbatim as testimonial cards on the site. Trailing incomplete clauses (Google's own truncation ellipsis '...') were trimmed to the last complete sentence; no words were changed or added.

photos.source_note: All 6 photos pulled directly from the business's own Google Maps photo listing via a Playwright scrape of the Maps photo panel (google.com/maps place page, left-column photo thumbnails), downloaded at full resolution (w1600-h1200) and verified with `file` as valid JPEGs before resizing. No stock imagery, no other business's photos.

palette_note: Copper/rust trade palette (accent-deep #9c4a1d, accent-mid #c17a42) on a warm ivory base, derived by hue-shifting the light-v2 template system toward burnt-copper/amber tones (distinct from the navy palette already used on serrano-handyman-kissimmee and invictus-handyman-cape-coral, both handyman builds in the same repo). Dark-band (CTA/footer) uses a warm dark brown-black (#241c14/#1b150e) with a light champagne-copper accent, consistent with the design system's token structure.
cta_channel: No booking platform, no verified social media. Primary CTA is tel:+12394605929 throughout (nav, hero, services cards, CTA final, book-float button); secondary CTA is sms:+12394605929 ('Send a text'), since SMS is a real, always-valid channel for this phone number and no Instagram/Facebook exists to use instead.
build_note: Built from templates/light-v2/index.html (copied from output/serrano-handyman-kissimmee/index.html, the same skeleton lineage, then re-derived) via an anchored Python transformation script (multiple passes, asserts on every replace: palette, then content section by section). Location section map iframe replaced with a real photo per pipeline rule (no published street address). Gallery expanded from the skeleton's 3-tile default to 4 tiles to use all 6 real photos across hero (1) + about (1) + gallery (4). GATE OK: python3 scripts/gate.py 239-handyman-can-capecoral --lang en --forbid "Mizu,Hialeah,Amani,Miami,Serrano,Kissimmee". Verified with Playwright (local headless) at 1440px and 390px viewports: zero horizontal overflow at either width, JSON-LD parses valid, zero em-dashes, ES/EN toggle verified working (html lang swaps, all data-es/data-en pairs render).
